concepts.gloss_en: the eyes of Israel are opened (spiritual perception granted to Israel specifically)
the eyes of the world are opened (perception granted to the whole world) — distinct from 'of Israel' by its possessed head

notes: Different possessed/genitive heads (של ישראל vs של העולם) = distinct concepts per rule 4. Both appear in lm2:67 but 'Israel' and 'the world' are not identical referents; keep separate (under-merge).
